eng-collapse.note: knees 0.00-0.18 s (frames 0-1), slump onto the side 0.18-0.45 s (frames 2-3), frame 4 holds from 0.45 s until RETRY. Reduced Motion: cut straight to frame 4.

wolf-liedown.note: frame 0 is the delivered walk3 wolf-idle frame_00 (standing; all WOLF death frames carry the walk3 grade); the WOLF reaction starts about 0.5 s after the hit; once he has walked in and stopped 40-48 px from the engineer, the lie-down takes 0.36 s and frame 3 holds until RETRY. Repeat death: straight to frame 3.

wolf-lookaway.note: one still pose, held until RETRY

wolf-lookaway-alt.note: alternates: the same pose with the head lower (not part of the row)

_cells.note: Same height, baseline row and pivot-to-centre offset as the walk rows (engineer 256x320, base 311, pivot 128 = centre; WOLF 512x272, base 263, pivot 293 = centre + 37); wider so the lying poses fit. Engineer pivot 288 = centre; WOLF pivot 357 = centre + 37.
